lead: XRP / XRP-USD — the lawsuit is over, the stockpile is next
smaller: Nvidia / NVDA — retail is bullish on the roadmap
Intel / INTC — the comeback hits hard decisions
ARK Innovation / ARKK — the influencer fund trims Meta
why_lead: XRP leads because its catalyst is new since every earlier lead. On March 19 the Ripple chief executive said the SEC is dropping its lawsuit and will drop its appeal (CNBC, Fortune, The Block, Ledger Insights), and the market data show XRP up 11.32% in the prior completed session, the largest move among the majors, with a dense news cluster. The March 3 lead covered the reserve naming, not the end of the case. The draft Tesla lead repeated the March 17 loyalty essay on the same Business Insider and CNBC evidence, so it is removed as a lead.
why_smaller: Nvidia is changed since the March 18 smaller, which was a keynote preview: the keynote has happened, Stocktwits reported a retail-bullish pre-market on March 19, and Fortune's March 14 item shows Nvidia overtaking Tesla as the most-held stock on Robinhood. Euronews reports a conflicting post-announcement fall, so no direction is claimed.

Intel is changed since the March 14 smaller on the appointment: the new chief executive's cost warning (March 17), Nvidia's statement that it has not been asked to buy an Intel stake (March 19), the March 19 options volume and a 6.94% reversal session replace the appointment story.

ARK Innovation is new as a trade: Cathie Wood appeared earlier only as a source (Tempus AI on March 4, the Tesla target on March 17), and the March 19 Meta sale and UiPath headlines are the first attention on this fund.
considered_not_chosen: Tesla (TSLA): removed as lead. The believer-loyalty essay repeats the March 17 lead on the same Business Insider and CNBC evidence, and Tesla has been a lead or smaller trade in eight of the thirteen earlier editions.
D-Wave (QBTS): the 82.13% five-session surge is the March 19 lead's catalyst and story again (Nvidia's quantum day, the six-stock pitch); a changed price alone does not justify a repeat.
Robinhood (HOOD): the prediction-markets hub and Kalshi launch were the March 18 lead, and the 8% jump is the same catalyst.
Rigetti (RGTI): the US$35M placement and the 57% share jump were already in the March 19 lead.
Affirm (AFRM) and Klarna: the Walmart partner loss was the March 18 smaller trade.
Hims & Hers (HIMS): smaller on March 17 and March 19; the March 19 knockoff item is the same compounded-drug story.
Joby Aviation (JOBY): the Virgin Atlantic retail-chatter story was the March 17 Archer smaller's theme.
Gold (GLD, GC=F): smaller on March 17 and March 19, and the March 19 record-high headline is covered there.

Sandisk (SNDK): smaller on March 10 with the relisting story; the March 19 YMTC price-rise item is a sector-price story with thin retail attention, and its 'soars' headline conflicts with the session's -0.16%.
Palantir (PLTR): smaller on March 6; the March 17 Reddit list and March 19 analyst pitch are generic attention.
Crypto majors and memecoins (BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, COIN, MSTR): the XRP lead covers the March 19 crypto bid, and Dogecoin appeared in three earlier smaller trades.
Nuclear (SMR, OKLO, NNE): the AI-power angle was used on March 4, March 11 and March 13.
Bridger Aerospace, Snap, Sangamo, Altimmune, USA Rare Earth: attention headlines with no market row, so no price evidence is allowed.
All candidates were compared with the thirteen earlier editions by title and by cited evidence ids before selection.
